title: Apple says gaming slowdown and App Store changes hurt services growth
summary: Overall, the App Store still set a June quarter revenue record, Apple noted, but that total figure also includes revenue from Apple Ads, which have become a more significant part of Apple’s business, and recently expanded to Apple Maps.
